UPDATE track_stages
         SET status = 'done', next_attempt_at = NULL,
             last_error = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_class = NULL,
             source = $4, evidence = $5, finished_at = now(), updated_at = now()
         WHERE track_id = $1 AND stage = $2 AND status = 'working' AND started_at = $3
